name: The Hall of Heroes
text: Beyond that iron door lies the Hall of Heroes — a proving ground where legends are forged or forgotten. I've seen a hundred warriors pass through it. Few earned the name. The door will open for any who carry the will to fight, but what waits inside... that's another matter. If you're half as capable as you look, I'd say go.

name: The Oracle's Marrow
text: Bring me a single vial of Starlight Nectar. It is liquid radiance, gathered only on the solstice and rarer than a dragon’s heart-blood. I know its resting place, but my bones are too brittle for the climb.Take this key; it will recognize the lock and part the stone for you. But heed my warning: the Vault is the private larder of Kargen the Cloud-Walker. He is a giant of the ancient peaks, and he has a short temper for thieves.
completionText: Look at that. Pure, cold starlight. It hasn't touched the earth in a thousand years. Kargen always did have a better eye for beauty than a giant deserves. Did he wake? No... don't tell me. If you're standing here, you were either silent or very, very lucky.

name: Life Essents
text: See that glow in your pack? That’s Life Essence. When you slay the monsters down there, their vital energy crystallizes. It’s the most versatile material in the world if you know how to handle it. Bring it to my forge, and I can weave it into your gear to make it stronger, sharper, and tougher.In here, essence is the only currency that truly matters
